title: Acid-Catalyzed Reduction of Ketones by an NADH Model Compound and the Relation with Acid-Catalyzed Photoinduced Electron-Transfer Reactions
abstract: Abstract                Various ketones are readily reduced by an acid-stable NADH model compound, 10-methylacridan (AcrH2), in the presence of perchloric acid in acetonitrile. Rates of the acid-catalyzed reduction of ketones by unprotonated AcrH2 are well correlated with rates of the acid-catalyzed photoinduced electron-transfer reactions from the excited state of [Ru(bpy)3]2+ to the ketones.
